description: Wicked Joe Coffee Goes Solar is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Wicked Joe Coffee; American Solar Energy Society. A coffee roasting business in Maine wanted to demonstrate their commitment to sustainability and secure a low-cost energy source. But could they really save money by installing a solar wall? Coverage: Maine (2017). The toolkit gives Maine as the location, 2017 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
